description.value: O'Falafel is a locally-owned Middle Eastern restaurant in Nanaimo serving traditional dishes including falafel sandwiches, shawarma wraps, hummus, baba ghanoush, and housemade grape leaves, all crafted with locally sourced ingredients. The owner-operated kitchen describes itself as a cultural gathering place drawing inspiration from classic Middle Eastern staples to create a diverse, community-focused dining experience. Takeout and delivery are available alongside dine-in service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.ofalafel.online/ is fully accessible and confirms an active Middle Eastern restaurant in Nanaimo offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery; the phone number shown on the website (250-591-5917) matches the OSM tag. The menu prominently features falafel, hummus, baba ghanoush, salads, and soups — all vegetarian — providing clear positive evidence for that amenity. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address is incomplete — only unit number (18) is recorded with no street name or postal code; the website also does not display a street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed phone number, and clearly described menu and services; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hearty meal with vegetarian options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes numerous vegetarian items: falafel sandwich, hummus, baba ghanoush, grape leaves, greek salad, tabouleh, fattoush, vegetable soup, lentil soup, cheese pastry, spinach pastry, and desserts (baklave, basbousa)

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: Most entrees $5.99–$9.99 (falafel wraps, shawarma, soups); casual Middle Eastern
